goal: Build a bounded candidate-first release refresh job that consumes existing PostgreSQL staging data, validates immutable Gear and Community candidates, classifies promotion risk, auto-promotes only proven safe changes, and preserves the active Manifest on every blocked or failed run.
userValue: Trusted observed gear can refresh on schedule without exposing partial sync output, illegal winners, mixed releases, silent baselines or unreviewed high-risk season changes.
nonGoals: No external download, API fetch or staging sync inside the release refresh job
No deploy-triggered release refresh service start
No automatic promotion for new season, rule, serializer, schema, capability or high-risk gear changes
No public baseline, recommendation, optimizer, BiS or DPS comparison behavior
No deletion or mutation of sealed releases, Manifests or release events
No removal of transitional staging readers or mutable sync tables
No Phase 5 SimC snapshot queue or Worker
No dependency installation or unapproved local download

currentTruth.publicPolicy: one legal raiderio observed winner per spec and zero baselines

mustChange: one bounded release refresh command consumes existing staging only and creates or reuses immutable inactive candidates before any pointer decision
same-Gear Community changes can auto-promote only after election, shadow, Resolver, Profile, browse, integrity and public-policy gates pass
a still-legal active winner lost by a candidate blocks promotion and leaves the active pointer unchanged
a newly illegal or expired active winner may become an explicit empty spec without baseline substitution and must report degraded truth
low-risk additive Gear changes require full 40-spec compatibility and a compatible Community Release before auto-promotion
new season, rule, serializer, schema, capability and high-risk Gear changes remain manual controlled cutovers
one systemd lock and one database-visible run state prevent overlapping release builds
health and admin expose bounded active, candidate, gate, promotion, rollback and timer facts without raw SQL, DSN or traceback
the release refresh timer is installed and enabled but deploy never starts the refresh service
mustNotChange: active pointer or public payload when a run is blocked, failed or lease-conflicted
sealed Gear, Community or Manifest content
observed-only winner and baseline-empty public semantics
staging sync writers and existing external-download ownership
legacy Profile and gear stats compatibility
Phase 6 Catalyst disabled and fail-closed state

manual candidate fixtures prove immutable reuse, exact release identities, full gate decisions and unchanged active pointer for blocked outcomes
candidate deployment installs timer/service without deploy-triggered execution and one controlled run records the expected event
40-spec public browse and canonical Resolve/Profile remain legal, release-consistent and baseline-free after any safe promotion
query, latency, memory, service, timer/backflow, health/admin, log and rollback evidence is captured at candidate and clean-main heads
backend/full verification, local CR, exact-head CI and runtime file parity pass before final live claim

engineeringHealth.reason: Release refresh is a new write-capable scheduled path over an already-active public Manifest. It must keep pure policy separate from SQL orchestration, reuse immutable identities, acquire one non-overlapping lease, fail before pointer CAS on any uncertainty, and expose bounded operational truth.

decisionLog.decision: The refresh consumes staging only. External sync/download ownership remains in existing jobs and a release run never fetches remote data.
Every run creates or reuses inactive candidates and finishes all gates before pointer CAS. A blocked or failed run cannot change the active Manifest.
Only same-Gear Community changes and fully compatible low-risk additive Gear changes are eligible for automatic promotion. All other risk classes require a controlled cutover.
Deploy installs and enables the timer but must not start the refresh service. Controlled candidate and post-merge runs are explicit operational actions.
Catalyst remains outside Phase 4. redirected_base_stats parser support does not enable the capability or alter promotion policy.
